sources.name: Airbus OneAtlas
sources.description: Commercial platform for Pleiades, Pleiades Neo, SPOT and SAR imagery with global basemap and sample/trial data. Browsing the catalog is free; imagery purchase requires an account.

sources.name: Allen Coral Atlas
sources.description: Global shallow reef maps (benthic habitat, geomorphic zones, bathymetry) derived from Planet satellite imagery at 5 m, downloadable under CC BY after registration.

sources.name: ASF HyP3 On-Demand SAR Processing
sources.description: Cloud service for on-demand RTC, InSAR (interferograms), autoRIFT and burst processing of Sentinel-1 and other SAR data. Free monthly quota with Earthdata login; outputs are GeoTIFFs.

sources.name: ASF DAAC Vertex
sources.description: Search and on-demand processing portal for SAR data: Sentinel-1, ALOS PALSAR, UAVSAR, SMAP, RADARSAT-1, ERS, JERS-1, Seasat, NISAR and OPERA products. Free with Earthdata login; links directly to HyP3.

sources.name: ASTER Global DEM (GDEM v3)
sources.description: Global 1 arc-second DEM from ASTER stereo imagery covering 83N-83S. Distributed via LP DAAC with Earthdata login.

sources.name: ASTER (Terra) Level-1T and Higher Products
sources.description: Archive of Terra ASTER VNIR/SWIR/TIR products (15/30/90 m), including surface temperature, emissivity and kinetic temperature; accessible via Earthdata Search with free login. The SWIR bands failed in 2008.

sources.name: Gateway to Astronaut Photography of Earth
sources.description: Archive of over 4 million photographs of Earth taken by astronauts from Mercury, Gemini, Apollo, Skylab, Shuttle and ISS (1961-present), searchable by place, date and camera, with Cities at Night. Free JPEG/RAW downloads and georeferencing for many frames.

sources.name: Registry of Open Data on AWS
sources.description: Searchable index of public datasets hosted on S3, including most major EO archives (Landsat, Sentinel-1/2, NAIP, GOES, Himawari, Copernicus DEM, Maxar open data, 3DEP lidar, MODIS, NISAR sample data). Most buckets are anonymous-read; some are requester-pays. Each entry lists bucket ARN, licence and tutorials.

sources.name: BlackSky Spectra / Imagery
sources.description: Commercial high-revisit high-resolution optical imagery (about 1 m) from the BlackSky Gen-2/Gen-3 constellation via the Spectra platform. Sample imagery is shown; data are sold.

sources.name: Brazil Data Cube
sources.description: INPE's data cube infrastructure with analysis-ready Landsat, Sentinel-2, CBERS-4 and MODIS cubes for Brazil, served via STAC and the sits R package. Open access with registration for processing services.
sources.notes: url did not load from automated fetch (403/502/TLS/DNS); site believed live, not confirmed URL moved 2026-11-05.

sources.name: EODMS (RADARSAT / RCM)
sources.description: Earth Observation Data Management System of Canada: archive of RADARSAT-1/2 and RADARSAT Constellation Mission (RCM) SAR data, plus aerial photos. Free registration; RCM data open under licence.

sources.name: Capella Space Open Data
sources.description: Sample SAR products (SLC, GEO, GEC, CPHD, SIDD) from Capella's X-band constellation, offered under CC BY 4.0 with a STAC catalog and AWS bucket.

sources.name: CODE-DE
sources.description: German national Copernicus access platform providing Sentinel data and Copernicus services for German public bodies and research, with EO Finder search and cloud resources. Registration is required for most services.

sources.name: Copernicus Browser (CDSE)
sources.description: Official viewer of the Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem for Sentinel-1/2/3/5P and other Copernicus data with band-math visualisation, time series and product download. Browsing is open; downloads and processing need a free CDSE account.

sources.name: Copernicus Marine Service (CMEMS)
sources.description: Satellite-based and model ocean products: SST, ocean colour, sea level, sea ice and waves, with Python toolbox, WMTS and subsetting service. Free account required.

sources.name: CREODIAS
sources.description: European DIAS cloud platform holding a mirror of Sentinel, Landsat and Copernicus service data with EO Finder search and a processing cloud. Searching is public; compute and some access need an account (commercial with trial).

sources.name: DESIS (ISS hyperspectral)
sources.description: DLR Earth Sensing Imaging Spectrometer on the ISS (30 m, 235 bands 400-1000 nm). Data are available through the Teledyne portal; also in DLR EOC and NASA catalogs.

sources.name: Digital Earth Pacific
sources.description: Pacific Islands data cube providing analysis-ready Landsat/Sentinel products and derived coastline, water and mangrove layers for Pacific nations, accessible via STAC and cloud storage.

sources.name: Dynamic World
sources.description: Near-real-time global 10 m land use/land cover probabilities for every Sentinel-2 scene since 2015, produced by a deep learning model. Accessible through Earth Engine and the Explorer web app.

sources.name: Element 84 Earth Search
sources.description: Free public STAC API indexing open datasets on AWS: Sentinel-2 L2A (COGs), Sentinel-1 GRD, Landsat C2 L2, NAIP, Copernicus DEM and others. No login needed; assets are links into open S3 buckets.

sources.name: Google Earth Timelapse
sources.description: Pan-and-zoom time-lapse of Landsat/Sentinel-2 composites (1984-2022) for any location; browse-only video-tile interface.

sources.name: ECOSTRESS (ISS thermal)
sources.description: ECOsystem Spaceborne Thermal Radiometer Experiment on Space Station: 70 m land-surface temperature, evapotranspiration and water-use efficiency. Data from LP DAAC (HDF5/COG), free Earthdata login.

sources.name: EO-1 Hyperion / ALI Archive
sources.description: Archive of the Hyperion hyperspectral imager (30 m, 220 bands) and Advanced Land Imager from the EO-1 mission (2000-2017). Downloads through EarthExplorer with free login.

sources.name: EOX Sentinel-2 Cloudless
sources.description: Global cloud-free Sentinel-2 mosaics (yearly, 2016 onward) and other layers (Sentinel-1, Blue Marble, terrain) served as WMS/WMTS, free for non-commercial use under CC BY-NC-SA. 10 m resolution.

sources.name: Esri Living Atlas of the World
sources.description: Esri's curated collection of maps and imagery layers (Landsat, Sentinel-2, NAIP, elevation, land cover) served as ArcGIS tile/image services, many open for viewing and reuse with attribution. Some layers need an ArcGIS account for analysis or export.

sources.name: Esri World Imagery Wayback
sources.description: Archive of dated versions of World Imagery since 2014, allowing comparison of how an area looked at different release dates. Releases are also served as tiles.

sources.name: Esri World Imagery
sources.description: Global high-resolution satellite and aerial basemap (down to roughly 0.3 m in many areas) compiled from Maxar, Airbus and national sources. Free to view as a tile service with attribution; usage terms restrict bulk download.

sources.name: FABDEM (Forest And Buildings removed Copernicus DEM)
sources.description: 30 m bare-earth DEM built by machine-learning removal of building and tree heights from Copernicus GLO-30, between 60S and 80N. Free for noncommercial use, tiled GeoTIFF downloads.
sources.notes: url did not load from automated fetch (403/502/TLS/DNS); site believed live, not confirmed URL moved 2026-11-05.

sources.name: Google Cloud Public Datasets (Earth observation)
sources.description: Google Cloud Storage and BigQuery public datasets, including the Landsat and Sentinel-2 archives mirrored to GCS buckets and other geospatial collections. Some buckets are requester-pays; metadata indexes are queryable in BigQuery.

sources.name: GEBCO Gridded Bathymetry
sources.description: Global ocean and land terrain model at 15 arc-second resolution, downloadable as NetCDF/GeoTIFF/ASCII, with WMS service and map viewer.

sources.name: Awesome GEE Community Catalog
sources.description: Community-maintained catalog of datasets shared as Earth Engine assets that are not in the official Earth Engine catalog. Complements the official catalog with regional and thematic products contributed by researchers.

sources.name: Global Human Settlement Layer (GHSL)
sources.description: Global built-up surface, population and settlement-model rasters (10 m - 1 km, 1975-2030 epochs) derived from Landsat, Sentinel-2 and census data. Downloadable GeoTIFF tiles, with a viewer.

sources.name: Global Forest Watch
sources.description: Web map and data API for derived forest-change layers (Hansen tree cover loss/gain, GLAD and RADD alerts, fires, land cover) based on Landsat, Sentinel and other imagery. Layer downloads need a free account.

sources.name: Global Mangrove Watch
sources.provider: Aberystwyth University / solo Earth Observation / Wetlands International
sources.description: Maps of mangrove extent and change from 1996 to 2020, derived from JAXA L-band SAR and Landsat, with web viewer and downloads.

sources.name: NOAA GOES-R on AWS
sources.description: GOES-16/17/18/19 ABI full-disk, CONUS, mesoscale L1b and L2 products (0.5-2 km, 16 bands) updated within minutes, free via S3 buckets and Zarr mirrors. NetCDF format.

sources.name: Google Earth Engine Data Catalog
sources.description: Browsable catalog of petabytes of public Earth-observation datasets (Landsat, Sentinel, MODIS, VIIRS, DEMs, climate, land cover) held in Earth Engine. Data are analysed through the Earth Engine code editor/API and exported; a Google account with Earth Engine registration is required (free for noncommercial use). Each dataset page links to the Earth Engine snippet, provider and licence.

sources.name: JMA Himawari-8/9 on AWS
sources.description: Himawari-8/9 AHI full-disk imagery (16 bands, 0.5-2 km, 10-min) archived on S3 from NOAA CLASS sharing in HSD and NetCDF format.

sources.name: Historic England Aerial Photography Collections
sources.description: Archive of oblique and vertical aerial photographs of England from the 1919 start onwards, catalogued online via the Historic England Archive search. Prints can be ordered.
sources.notes: url did not load from automated fetch (403/502/TLS/DNS); site believed live, not confirmed

sources.name: HISUI Hyperspectral (Japan Space Systems)
sources.description: Hyperspectral Imager SUIte on the ISS Kibo module (20-30 m, 185 bands 400-2500 nm). Data are distributed via Japanese portals such as Tellus and Japan Space Systems' hosted service.

sources.name: ICEYE Open Data
sources.description: Free sample X-band SAR collections from ICEYE satellites covering emergencies, ships and example imaging modes, distributed as GeoTIFF/SLC/COG via AWS S3 and STAC.

sources.name: IGN Remonter le temps
sources.description: Compare current and historical aerial photographs and maps of France from the 1920s, including post-war missions. Browse free, in French.

sources.name: GSI Japan Aerial Photograph Archive (Maps and Air Photos Reader)
sources.description: Search and view historic aerial photos, including 1940s US Army coverage, and orthophotos of Japan. Site in Japanese; browsing free.

sources.name: GSI Japan Fundamental Geospatial Data (DEM)
sources.description: Download service for Japan's basic geospatial data including 5 m and 10 m DEM tiles in XML. The site is in Japanese; registration is free.

sources.name: JRC Global Surface Water Explorer
sources.description: Maps of surface water occurrence, change, seasonality and transitions from 1984 onward, derived from the Landsat archive at 30 m. Downloadable as tiled GeoTIFF; also in Earth Engine.

sources.name: Landsat Collection 2 on AWS (USGS Landsat)
sources.description: Landsat 4-9 Collection 2 Level-1 and Level-2 (surface reflectance and surface temperature) as COGs on a requester-pays S3 bucket, with the USGS STAC. Includes thermal TIRS bands at 100 m.

sources.name: Landsat MSS Collection 2 (1972-1999)
sources.description: Landsat Collection 2 including Landsat 1-5 MSS Level-1 data (60-80 m), the earliest civil Earth multispectral archive. Downloads are COGs through EarthExplorer or LandsatLook.

sources.name: Retrolens (LINZ historical aerial photos)
sources.description: Free download of scanned historical aerial photographs of New Zealand 1936-2005, searchable by place. Uses image access with a free account.

sources.name: NASA LP DAAC (land processes)
sources.description: Land products from MODIS, VIIRS, ASTER, ECOSTRESS, EMIT, HLS, NASADEM, SRTM, GEDI and more, free with Earthdata login through Earthdata Search, AppEEARS and cloud buckets.

sources.name: Major TOM (Hugging Face)
sources.description: Large ML-ready tiled Sentinel-1 RTC and Sentinel-2 L1C/L2A collections on a standard global grid, openly hosted on Hugging Face. Easy to sample by grid cell; aimed at EO machine learning.

sources.name: Maxar (Vantor) Open Data Program
sources.description: Pre- and post-event high-resolution (30-50 cm) satellite imagery released openly under CC BY-NC 4.0 for major disasters, as COGs on AWS with a STAC catalog. Event listings are on the Maxar/Vantor open-data page.

sources.name: MERIT DEM
sources.description: Global 3 arc-second (90 m) multi-error-removed improved-terrain DEM built from SRTM and AW3D. Download after a brief request form.

sources.name: Microsoft Planetary Computer Data Catalog
sources.description: Catalog of open planetary-scale Earth datasets (Landsat, Sentinel-1/2/3/5P, NAIP, MODIS, Copernicus DEM, ALOS, ASTER, 3DEP lidar and more) stored as COG/Zarr in Azure Blob. Every collection is searchable through a public STAC API; anonymous access works but short-lived SAS tokens are fetched from the API for downloads.

sources.name: Planetary Computer Explorer
sources.description: Web map for previewing and querying Planetary Computer collections over any area and date range, with rendering presets for each dataset. Useful for quick visual inspection before pulling data through the STAC API.

sources.name: NASA Earth Observations (NEO)
sources.description: Browse and download monthly or 8-day global rasters of ocean colour, sea-surface temperature, vegetation, cloud, fire and aerosol products as GeoTIFF, PNG or CSV at 0.1 degree. Lightweight and no login.

sources.name: PACE Ocean Color Instrument data
sources.description: Plankton, Aerosol, Cloud, ocean Ecosystem hyperspectral radiometer (OCI, 1 km, 340-890 nm plus SWIR) data from Feb 2024: L1B, L2 ocean/aerosol/land and L3 mapped products. NetCDF files; free Earthdata login for download.

sources.name: NASA Visible Earth
sources.description: Catalog of NASA Earth imagery and visualisations, including Blue Marble composites, Black Marble and global imagery at several resolutions.

sources.name: NCAP - National Collection of Aerial Photography
sources.description: Over 30 million aerial photographs of the world's cultural heritage taken since 1920, including RAF/Luftwaffe WWII and post-war coverage plus WWII captured imagery. Search free; downloads are purchased.
sources.notes: url did not load from automated fetch (403/502/TLS/DNS); site believed live, not confirmed

sources.name: NEON Airborne Observation Platform
sources.description: Annual airborne hyperspectral (1 m, 426 bands), lidar and RGB imagery over NEON sites in the US. Free downloads via the NEON data portal and API.

sources.name: Actueel Hoogtebestand Nederland (AHN)
sources.description: National Dutch elevation dataset: airborne lidar point clouds and 0.5 m DTM/DSM rasters, openly available via PDOK, with a viewer and WCS/WMS services.

sources.name: NICT Himawari Real-time Image
sources.description: Latest true-colour full-disk Himawari images with 10-minute updates and archive tiles, free to browse and download.

sources.name: NOAA AVHRR Polar Orbiter archive
sources.description: NOAA NCEI holdings of AVHRR polar-orbiter data (1 km, 1978-present) used for long climate records.

sources.name: National Air Photo Library (Canada)
sources.description: World's largest collection of Canadian aerial photographs, over 6 million frames since 1920; catalog online, many digitised and purchasable.

sources.name: Open Data Cube
sources.description: Open-source software and directory of national and regional data cubes (Australia, Africa, Colombia, Vietnam, Switzerland, Pacific and others). A good entry for finding additional ODC deployments with analysis-ready EO time series.

sources.name: OpenAerialMap
sources.description: Open repository of community-contributed drone, aircraft and satellite imagery under CC-BY, searchable by map with a REST API and STAC. Imagery is served as COG/TMS and directly downloadable.

sources.name: openEO Platform / openEO CDSE
sources.description: Open API and federated back ends for cloud processing of EO data (Sentinel, Landsat, DEMs) with Python, R and JavaScript clients and a web editor. The CDSE-hosted back end offers a free tier after login; results download as GeoTIFF/NetCDF.

sources.name: Pixxel Hyperspectral Data
sources.description: Indian hyperspectral operator (Firefly/Honeybee constellation, 5 m, 135+ bands) that publishes sample open datasets and a data catalog; portal for samples and commercial orders.

sources.name: Planet Education and Research Program
sources.description: Limited free access to PlanetScope/SkySat imagery quotas for qualifying academic and non-profit researchers via application. Data come through Planet Explorer and the APIs.

sources.name: Planet NICFI Tropical Basemaps
sources.provider: Planet Labs / Norway's International Climate & Forests Initiative
sources.description: Monthly/bi-monthly 4.77 m RGB+NIR basemaps of the tropics (2015-2024) previously free for noncommercial use under the NICFI program. Access via Planet account and Basemaps API; check current program status as terms have changed.

sources.name: Carbon Mapper Data Portal (Tanager / airborne plumes)
sources.description: Methane and CO2 plume detections and hyperspectral (VSWIR) imagery from Tanager-1 and airborne campaigns, released openly through the Carbon Mapper data portal. Includes plume imagery and scene-level data.

sources.name: CIRA RAMMB SLIDER
sources.description: Zoomable full-resolution viewer for GOES-East/West, Himawari, GK-2A, Meteosat, JPSS and others with band combinations and loops, plus tile downloads.

sources.name: Satellogic Open Data (EarthView)
sources.description: EarthView open dataset of Satellogic multispectral imagery (about 1 m, RGB+NIR) for selected sites and research, hosted on AWS with a STAC catalog.

sources.name: Sentinel-1 on AWS / Earth Search
sources.description: Sentinel-1 GRD and SLC archive mirrored to AWS (C-band, 10 m), searchable via the Earth Search STAC API.

sources.name: Sentinel-5P Pre-Operations Data Hub / TROPOMI
sources.description: Reprocessed and operational Sentinel-5 Precursor TROPOMI atmospheric products (NO2, O3, CH4, CO, SO2, HCHO, aerosol; about 5.5x3.5 km) in NetCDF. Operational data are on CDSE; this portal hosts the PAL reprocessed record.

sources.name: Sentinel Asia
sources.description: Disaster-response imagery sharing network for Asia-Pacific with emergency observation requests and image archives from ALOS-2, Sentinel, Planet and others, available to members and via public event pages.

sources.name: SkyWatch EarthCache
sources.description: Single API to search and order imagery across commercial and public satellites. Paid, account needed.

sources.name: Source Cooperative
sources.description: Neutral data-publishing hub from Radiant Earth hosting large geospatial datasets (cloud-native COGs, GeoParquet, Zarr, PMTiles) from many organisations; successor for Radiant MLHub ML training sets. Repositories are browsable and mostly anonymously readable over HTTPS/S3.

sources.name: SpaceNet
sources.description: Open labelled EO imagery datasets (WorldView, Planet, Capella SAR) for building, road and flood segmentation challenges, hosted free on AWS S3.

sources.name: PNOA Spain (aerial orthophotos and lidar)
sources.description: Plan Nacional de Ortofotografía Aérea: national aerial orthophotos (25-50 cm), historic flights and PNOA-LiDAR point clouds for Spain, downloadable free from the CNIG centro de descargas. Site in Spanish.

sources.name: SRTM Global 1 arc-second
sources.description: Shuttle Radar Topography Mission 30 m elevation tiles from the Feb 2000 flight. Distributed through LP DAAC with Earthdata login (HGT format).

sources.name: STAC Index
sources.description: Directory of public STAC catalogs and APIs worldwide, with links to compatible clients and tools. Handy for discovering regional or mission STAC endpoints not listed individually here.

sources.name: Swiss Data Cube
sources.description: Open Data Cube for Switzerland with analysis-ready Landsat and Sentinel-2 data, accessed through notebooks and a viewer.

sources.name: swisstopo SWISSIMAGE / swissALTI3D
sources.description: Swiss national 10 cm orthoimage mosaics (SWISSIMAGE) and elevation models (swissALTI3D, swissSURFACE3D lidar), all open data downloadable as COG and via STAC.

sources.name: swisstopo Time Travel (historical aerial images)
sources.description: Interactive viewer of Swiss orthophoto mosaics from 1946 to present and historical maps, with free download of SWISSIMAGE (10 cm) tiles.

sources.name: Terrascope (VITO)
sources.description: Belgian EO platform offering Sentinel-1/2/3, PROBA-V and Copernicus Global Land Service products, with a viewer, catalogue, OGC services and virtual machines. Many products are open; some services need registration.

sources.name: Umbra SAR Open Data
sources.description: Free high-resolution (sub-meter) X-band SAR imagery (GEC, SICD, SIDD, CPHD) of selected locations, hosted on an open S3 bucket and listed in a STAC catalog. CC BY 4.0.

sources.name: Copernicus Emergency Management Service (Rapid Mapping)
sources.description: Catalog of activations with satellite-derived delineation and grading maps for floods, fires and earthquakes, with downloadable vector and map products and links to source imagery.

sources.name: UP42 Data Marketplace
sources.description: Marketplace and API aggregating commercial and open EO data from many providers for search, tasking and processing. Registration needed; data are paid.

sources.name: USGS EROS Aerial Photography Single Frames
sources.description: Scans of aerial photographs for the US and territories from the 1930s onward (NAPP, NHAP, etc.) accessible via EarthExplorer, free; scanned frames as TIFF.

sources.name: USGS Declassified Satellite Imagery 2 and 3 (KH-7 Gambit, KH-9 Hexagon)
sources.description: Declassified KH-7 Gambit and KH-9 Hexagon mapping camera imagery (1963-1984), covering the globe at roughly 0.6-9 m. Access through EarthExplorer; scans as TIFF.

sources.name: WEkEO
sources.description: Copernicus DIAS with unified access to Sentinel, Copernicus Marine, Atmosphere, Land and Climate data, offering the Harmonised Data Access API (HDA) and a Jupyter environment. A free account is required.

sources.name: Zoom Earth
sources.description: Near-real-time viewer of geostationary and polar imagery (GOES, Himawari, Meteosat, GK-2A, VIIRS, MODIS) with hurricane/fire tracks and high-resolution archived satellite basemaps. Browse-only, no data download.
